title: How a wrong turn started WWI
subtitle: 17 million dead. one sandwich.
scriptText: Wait. You really don't know how World War One started? Sit down. 17 million dead. Started because of one wrong turn. 1914. Sarajevo. Archduke Franz Ferdinand is visiting. Six assassins are waiting. First attempt: bomb thrown at his car. Bomb bounces off. Misses. Archduke survives. The Archduke decides: I'll visit the wounded in the hospital. New route. But nobody tells the driver. Driver takes the OLD route. Wrong turn. Realizes the mistake, stops to back up. Stops EXACTLY in front of one of the other assassins. Who is eating a sandwich. Sandwich guy can't believe his luck. Pulls out his pistol. Shoots the Archduke. Six weeks later: World War One. Because of a sandwich. And a wrong turn. You're welcome.
